definitions: A mass of incombustible matter fused together, such as slag or vitrified ash.
A brick that is overburned and consequently hard, dense, and often misshapen.
A type of boat construction in which the planks overlap.
A mistake or error, especially a noticeable one.
examples: The furnace produced a lot of clinker.
The old house was built with clinker bricks.
That last remark was a real clinker.
